pattern.name: Hero + Features + CTA
pattern.sections: Hero with headline/image > Value prop > Key features (3-5) > CTA section > Footer

pattern.conversion: Deep CTA placement. For CTA label text, verify at least 4.5:1 against the button fill; use 7:1 only when the product explicitly targets AAA normal-text contrast. motion_snippet.GSAP Snippet: gsap.from(el, { opacity: 0, y: 12, duration: 0.35, ease: 'power1.out', scrollTrigger: { trigger: el, start: 'top 90%', toggleActions: 'play none none reverse' } });
motion_snippet.Framework Notes: Requires the ScrollTrigger plugin registered once via gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger); Use matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') to skip non-essential motion and render the final state immediately
motion_snippet.Do: Keep the y offset small (8-16px) so it reads as a fade, not a slide
motion_snippet.Don't: Don't reveal below-the-fold content needed for SEO/crawlers as invisible-by-default without a no-JS fallback
motion_snippet.Performance Notes: toggleActions 'play none none reverse' avoids re-triggering on every scroll direction change

results.Description: An error summary for failed validation complements inline field errors and must be easy to find by keyboard and screen reader users
results.Do: Place it at the top of the form; move focus to its heading or container after failed submit; link each item to its invalid field; retain inline errors
results.Don't: Replace inline errors with a visual-only summary or move focus on every blur
results.Code Example Good:
There is a problem

Enter an email address
results.Code Example Bad: Toast only with no field links or focus target

results.Description: Error messages must be announced
results.Do: Use aria-live or role=alert for errors

results.Description: Each invalid field needs an inline error connected to that field
results.Do: Show a specific error below the input and reference it with aria-describedby
results.Don't: Show only a top-level error without identifying each invalid field

results.Description: Handle long text gracefully
results.Do: truncate or line-clamp-*

results.Description: Handle chip and badge text overflow without breaking compact labels or hiding collection values
results.Do: Use flex flex-wrap gap-2 for collections; for one label use whitespace-nowrap bounded min-w-0 truncate and shrink-0 controls
results.Don't: Clip a fixed-height row let labels wrap inside a pill or let dismiss icons shrink
results.Code Good: flex flex-wrap gap-2; label min-w-0 whitespace-nowrap truncate; icon shrink-0

results.Description: Give image wrappers an aspect ratio or dimensions to avoid layout shifts
results.Do: aspect-video or explicit dimensions
results.Don't: Let images determine layout after load

results.Description: Use loading.tsx for route loading UI
results.Do: loading.tsx alongside page.tsx

results.Description: Client-side navigation with prefetching
results.Do: <Link href=""> for internal links

results.Description: Keep components styles tests with their routes
results.Do: Component files alongside page.tsx

results.Description: Dialog component for overlay modal windows
results.Do: Dialog for confirmations forms details

results.Description: Render validation messages with FieldError
results.Do: FieldError with controller fieldState errors

results.Description: Use a Standard Schema compatible validator such as Zod where it adds value
results.Do: Zod schema with resolver or form adapter
results.Don't: Assume Zod is the only supported validator

results.Description: Include every reactive value used inside an Effect dependency array.
results.Do: All referenced values in dependency array

results.Guideline: Use an Effect Event for non-reactive effect logic
results.Description: Use useEffectEvent to separate event-like logic from reactive Effect dependencies.
results.Do: Read latest props and state inside useEffectEvent callbacks
results.Don't: Use useEffectEvent to hide missing dependencies

results.Description: Avoid Effects for derived data or event handling.
results.Do: Transform data during render handle events directly
results.Don't: useEffect for derived state or event handling

results.Description: Anchor links should scroll smoothly to target section
results.Do: Use scroll-behavior: smooth on html element

results.Description: Tables can overflow on mobile
results.Do: Use horizontal scroll or card layout

results.Description: Avoid horizontal scrolling
results.Do: Ensure content fits viewport width

results.Description: WCAG 2.2 AAA requires keyboard focus to remain fully visible
results.Do: Keep the entire focused component unobscured by author-created content
results.Don't: Present this enhanced AAA criterion as an AA requirement or allow persistent UI to hide any part of focus
results.Code Example Good: close persistent overlay before focus moves behind it
results.Code Example Bad: sticky footer covers half the focused button

results.Description: WCAG 2.2 AA requires keyboard focus to remain at least partially visible
results.Do: Offset sticky UI with scroll-padding and dismiss or move persistent overlays
results.Don't: Let headers footers banners or chat widgets fully cover focus

results.Description: WCAG 2.2 AAA defines minimum area and contrast for focus indicators
results.Do: Use an indicator at least as large as a 2 CSS px perimeter with 3:1 state contrast
results.Don't: Present this enhanced AAA criterion as an AA requirement or use a thin low-contrast outline

results.Keywords: decorative icon aria hidden, meaningful icon text alternative, icon button accessible label, accessible name, aria pressed, aria expanded, semantic context, phosphor, heroicons
results.Import Code: import { Question } from '@phosphor-icons/react'; import { QuestionMarkCircleIcon } from '@heroicons/react/24/outline';
results.Usage: Prefer the most semantically precise Phosphor icon, even if it is outside this curated subset. Use Heroicons only as a consistent fallback. Keep one visual family per surface. Context is chosen by use: if decorative beside visible text, set aria-hidden="true"; if meaningful without equivalent visible text, provide a text alternative; if inside an interactive control, give the control an accessible name and expose applicable state (for example aria-pressed or aria-expanded).
results.Best For: Contextual icon semantics, icon accessibility, and library fallback rules

results.Keywords: waffle, percentage, proportion, progress, filled, grid, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart
results.When to Use: Showing what fraction of a whole is filled; percentage progress in a visually engaging and accessible format
results.When NOT to Use: More than 5 categories (use stacked bar); exact values matter over visual proportion; very tight space
results.Data Volume Threshold: 10×10 grid standard (100 cells); for > 5 categories switch to stacked 100% bar
results.Color Guidance: 3–5 categories max. 2–3px gap between cells. Each category a distinct accessible color pair
results.Accessibility Notes: Label each category and percentage and add patterns or symbols; filled-cell color alone is insufficient.
results.A11y Fallback: Percentage table/list plus part-to-whole summary. Keyboard: focus reveals each cell value.

results.Keywords: performance, target, kpi, gauge, goal, threshold, progress, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart
results.When to Use: Single KPI measured against a defined target or threshold; dashboard summary context
results.When NOT to Use: No target or benchmark exists; comparing multiple KPIs at once (use bullet chart grid)
results.Data Volume Threshold: Single metric per gauge; for 3+ KPIs use bullet chart grid layout
results.Color Guidance: Performance: Red → Yellow → Green gradient. Target: marker line. Threshold zones clearly differentiated
results.Accessibility Notes: Place the number and target text beside the gauge and label threshold zones; red/yellow/green alone is insufficient.
results.A11y Fallback: Visible KPI/target text and a one-row data table plus status summary. Keyboard: focus reveals the same detail as hover.

results.Keywords: trend, time-series, line, growth, timeline, progress, accessible chart, keyboard accessible chart
results.When to Use: Data has a time axis; user needs to observe rise/fall trends or rate of change over a continuous period
results.When NOT to Use: Fewer than 4 data points (use stat card); more than 6 series (visual noise); no time dimension exists
results.Data Volume Threshold: <1000 pts: SVG; ≥1000 pts: Canvas + downsampling; >10000: aggregate to intervals
results.Color Guidance: Primary: #0080FF. Multiple series: distinct colors + distinct line styles. Fill: 20% opacity
results.Accessibility Notes: Use solid, dashed, and dotted line styles plus direct series labels; never distinguish series by hue alone.
results.A11y Fallback: Visible data table plus concise trend summary. Keyboard: focus reveals hover values; +/- buttons zoom; Reset restores the full range.
